note: Free town-run camper park in Lovell beside the ball fields at 40 Quebec Ave, with shaded pull-through lanes and tent spots between them; donations requested. Summer only (closed and fenced off in the off-season). Trains pass 1-2 blocks north. Handy base for Bighorn Canyon NRA. --Claude

Google 4.5 (114). Site count unconfirmed. Not waterfront kept.
